description:
Meet the Ranger.
A new addition to the P-51 lineup, built for riders who want the signature P-51 look and feel in a hardtail platform. Featuring front suspension by KKE, fresh new colorways, and the same rider-focused design philosophy that defines every P-51. Whether you're cruising the neighborhood, exploring new routes, or taking the long way home, the Ranger is ready for the ride.

Suspension: The Ranger features a 27-inch KKE front suspension fork designed to smooth out rough roads, trails, and everyday terrain. Paired with the hardtail frame, it delivers a responsive ride with confident handling and a direct connection to the trail.
Battery: High quality LG 21700 cell 48 volt - 20 AH lithium-ion battery paired with a powerful BMS. The Ace also comes with a 3 amp quick charger for fast recharge! Riders will get an estimated range 40+ miles on throttle only (varies due to riding style)
Brakes: The Ranger is equipped with the legendary Magura MT4e dual piston hydraulic brakes front and rear and 203mm oversize rotors for increased stopping and overall brake performance
Wheels and Tires: The Ranger uses 20 inch x 4 inch CST Scout tires for street and dirt performance.
Compliance: This bike does not need to be registered and is Class 2 compliant
